def count_rotation(arr):
    """
    Count the number of rotations required to generate a sorted array.
    Returns the first index i where arr[i] < arr[i-1], else 0.
    """
    n = len(arr)
    for i in range(1, n):
        if arr[i] < arr[i - 1]:
            return i
    return 0
